audit_items.proof_trace: ENR epoch is derived from slots.NewSlotTicker() which uses wall-clock time (time.Now()) via slots.CurrentSlot(). The fork watcher computes currentEpoch = slots.ToEpoch(currSlot) where currSlot comes from wall-clock-based ticker, then calls GetNetworkScheduleEntry(currentEpoch) and updateENR(). No dependency on sync state exists.
